name: Planner: 'Use latest exit' turns a failing plan into one that fits

planSteps.description: Navigate to /?today=2026-10-19&fresh=1 (pins today to 2026-10-19 and clears saved trips)
In the planned trip form (data-testid=planned-form) enter planned entry 2026-12-01 and planned exit 2027-03-15, then click check (data-testid=planned-check)
The planned trip result (data-testid=planned-result) starts with 'Does not fit' and names 2027-01-15 as the latest legal exit
The planned trip result now starts with 'Fits.' and says 46 days, from 2026-12-01 to 2027-01-15
Only one planned trip result is shown
